name: Lumbar Epidural Lipomatosis
definition: Excess epidural fat in the lumbar canal causing neural compression, often associated with obesity, steroid exposure or endocrinopathy.

investigations.principle: MRI demonstrates characteristic epidural fat and compression.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Address steroid exposure and obesity where possible
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Medo/Vata phenotype may be documented in parallel only.

patientEducation.summary: Excess epidural fat in the lumbar canal causing neural compression, often associated with obesity, steroid exposure or endocrinopathy.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
